weekend.d: Meet every team once: Endgame for where the Avengers left off, X2 for the legacy mutants, Deadpool & Wolverine for the bridge between universes, Thunderbolts* for the New Avengers, and First Steps for the Fantastic Four and Doom.

official.d: Disney+'s official “Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday” collection, in the order it was reported. Keep the two X-Men films together, Infinity War with Endgame, and both Loki seasons back to back.

deep.d: Not on the official list, but these fill in the backstories of confirmed characters. VisionQuest's finale (Nov 10) now includes a direct Doomsday tease. Brand New Day had its theatrical run this summer.
